description.value: Sea Island Community Centre is a City of Richmond public facility situated on Sea Island, the same island that hosts Vancouver International Airport, making it a rare community hub in an otherwise airport-dominated landscape. The two-storey building serves the small residential population of Sea Island and would be a natural rest stop for cyclists navigating the flat, dyke-lined roads of this area. As a municipal community centre, it is likely to offer standard civic amenities, though none can be confirmed from available evidence.
